messages:
Morgan (eng-platform): brief idea: "shadow everywhere, probe stratified, gate cutovers by a logic box". aim: avoid slow weight ramps but be safe.
June (architecture): ok but we need clear semantics for 'logic box' (what signals, how aggregated). and traceability when an auto-cut flips.
Alex (eng-runtime): runtime constraints: shadows must be non-blocking and not touch KV writes. implement as one-way fire-and-forget with bounded queue and drop-on-overflow. tag X-Shadow:1.
Iris (eng-sre): signals: p99 latency, error-rate, and a token-cost spike check. gating: require (latency OR errors) AND precondition(pass capacity-check). prevents falling into overloaded targets.
Dee (eng-ml): sampling: stratify by seq_len and call-type. plus a small canonical prompt set run on each variant for semantic drift. combine metrics into a score.
Morgan (eng-platform): proposed gate logic: 
```
if (p99 > baseline*1.4 for 3m OR errors > 1%) AND target_has_capacity AND semantic_score_drop < 0.05 => trigger fallback
```
June (architecture): include an override: route-level opt-out and human-in-loop TTL for auto-fallback. all auto actions must emit audit events with reason and correlation id.
Alex (eng-runtime): session-affinity: when switching routes, prefer draining existing sessions to avoid mid-conversation flips. implement sticky TTL and gradual weight shift confined to new sessions.
Iris (eng-sre): runbook: auto-fallback creates a P2 page if both primary and fallback targets fail health checks after 5m. otherwise annotate and notify owners.
Dee (eng-ml): metrics to store: baseline distributions by seq_len, recent quantiles, semantic drift embeddings. thresholds are per-model-profile.
deploy-bot: mirror-pipeline: deployed to canary; probe-agent: started
Morgan (eng-platform): next steps: Alex proto non-blocking mirror, Dee assemble canary prompts, Iris write probe escalation rules, June draft config RFC. short and actionable.
